```{r}
#| label: setup

rm(list = ls())
#
library("gtsummary")
library("kableExtra")
library("labelled")
library("naniar")
library("readODS")
library("corrplot")
library("biostats")
library("colorspace")
library("apyramid")
 library("lme4")
library("lmerTest")
library("performance")
library("baseph")
library("tidyverse")
library("survival")
library("survminer")

load("datas/follow.RData")
expx <- FALSE
classeur <- "follow_n_v1.ods"
#
ptest <- list(all_continuous() ~ "t.test", all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test")
stt <- list(
  all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ± {sd}",
  all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)"
)
#
#
theme_set(
  theme_light() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
)
scale_fill_cav <- function(...) scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", begin = 0.4, ...)
scale_colour_cav <- function(...) scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "plasma", begin = 0.4, end = 0.8, ...)
```

# Échantillon

L'échantillon comporte `r nrow(tt)` cas pour `r ncol(tt)` variables utilisables : les variables vides ou constantes ont été supprimées ains que les "if\dots" comportant trop peu de réponses. 

## Données manquantes

La notion de $donnée manquante$ n'a de sens que pour les données à l'inclusion.  

```{r}
#| label: tbl-manq
#| tbl-cap: Données manquantes

tt |> 
  dplyr::select(center:patient_receive_a_treatment,ecog:type_treatment_1) |>
  dplyr::select(! starts_with("if")) |> 
  dplyr::select(! opportunistic_infections) |> 
  miss_var_summary() |> 
  dplyr::slice(1:10)
```



# Description de la population

```{r}
#| label: tbl-demog
#| tbl-cap: Données démographiques

tt |> 
  dplyr::select(sex:initial_diagnosis, ecog:score_cirs,tp53_status,igvh_status) |> 
    tbl_summary(missing = "no",sort = all_categorical() ~ "frequency") |> 
  add_ci() |> 
   modify_header(label = " ") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
  add_n() |> 
  gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "demog", lg = TRUE) 
  

```


```{r}

tt |>

  dplyr::select(! starts_with("if")) |> 
    tbl_summary(missing = "no",sort = all_categorical() ~ "frequency") |> 
  add_ci() |> 
   modify_header(label = " ") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
  add_n() |>

```




```{r}
#| label: tbl-nsuivi
#| tbl-cap: Nombre de patients suivis

zz <-  tt |> 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("date_follow_up")) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything()) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), as.factor)) |> 
  mutate(name = str_sub(name,-3)) |> 
  mutate(Month = case_when(
    name == "t_1" ~ "Inclusion",
    TRUE ~ name  )) |> 
  drop_na(value)
   

zz |> 
  dplyr::select(Month) |> 
  tbl_summary(statistic = list( all_categorical() ~ "{n}")) |> 
   modify_header(label = " ") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
  gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "nsuivi", lg = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-nsuivi
#| fig-cap: Nombre de patients suivis

zz |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .by = Month) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = n)) +
  geom_line(group = 1) +
  geom_point(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Number of patients") 
  
  
```




# Critère principal


## Première ligne ou non

```{r}
tt |> 
  #| label: tbl-tt1lig
#| tbl-cap: Traitement de première intention ou non
#| 
  dplyr::select(tt1,patient_receive_a_treatment) |>
  tbl_summary(by = patient_receive_a_treatment) |> 
  add_p()|> 
  bold_p() |>
  modify_header(label = "") |>
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**previous treatment**") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
    gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "tt1lig", lg = TRUE)

```

```{r}
#| label: prepaprem

tti <- tt |> 
  dplyr::filter(patient_receive_a_treatment == "no") 
```

On ne prend en compte que les patients en première ligne de traitement à l'inclusion soit `r nrow(tti)` patients.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tt1
#| tbl-cap: Traitement de première intention

tti |> 
  dplyr::select(tt1) |> 
  tbl_summary() |> 
  add_ci() |> 
   modify_header(label = " ") |>
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**N (%)**") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
  gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "tt1", lg = TRUE)
```


Un patient a reçu venetoclax & BTKi & a été classé en `venetoclax`.

## Traitement initial vs population

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tt1demog
#| tbl-cap: Traitement de première intention selon la population

tti |> 
  dplyr::select(tt1, sex, agec,initial_diagnosis,binet_stage_at_diagnosis, patient_receive_a_treatment) |> 
  tbl_summary(by = tt1, 
              missing = "no",sort = all_categorical() ~ "frequency", 
              percent = "row") |>
  add_p() |>
  add_n() |> 
  bold_p() |>
   modify_header(label = " ") |>
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**N (%)**") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
  gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "tt1demog", lg = FALSE)
```

# Avant l'inclusion


```{r}
#| label: tbl-ttav1
#| tbl-cap: Lignes de traitement avant l'inclusion

tt |> 
  dplyr::select(patient_receive_a_treatment,if_yes_number_lines_before) |> 
  tbl_summary( missing = "no",sort = all_categorical() ~ "frequency") |> 
  add_n() |> 
   modify_header(label = " ") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
  gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur,
            nomsheet = "ttav1", lg = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ttav2
#| tbl-cap: Type de traitement reçu avant l'inclusion

typ <- tibble(ttant =c(tt$type_1_line_therapy,tt$type_2_line_therapy,
         tt$type_3_line_therapy,tt$type_4_line_therapy,
         tt$type_5_line_therapy,tt$type_6_line_therapy,
         tt$type_7_line_therapy
         ))
typ <- typ |>  
  drop_na() |> 
mutate(ttant =  
case_when(
  str_detect(ttant, "venetocl") ~ "venetoclax",
  str_detect(ttant, "inib") ~ "BTKi",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
))

typ |> 
  tbl_summary( missing = "no",
               sort = all_categorical() ~ "frequency") |> 
  add_n() |> 
   modify_header(label = " ") |>
  bold_labels() |> 
  gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "tt1av2", lg = TRUE)
```


# Courbe de survie

## Survie globale 

```{r}
#| label: fig-surv_glob
#| fig-cap: Courbe de survie

tt <- tt |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(dmax = max(c_across(starts_with("date_")), na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(dcd = if_else(status_at_end_study == "Death", 1, 0, missing = 0)) |> 
  mutate(suivi = as.numeric(dmax - date_inclusion)/30.5)
dd <- Surv(time = tt$suivi, event = tt$dcd)
ddt <- survfit(dd ~ tt$agec)
ggsurvplot(
  ddt,
  data = tt,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  xlab = "Time in months",
  ylab = "Survival probability",
  title = "Kaplan-Meier survival curve",
  legend.title = "Survival curve",
  risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
  risk.table.y.text = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-surv_rech
#| fig-cap: Courbe de survie ou rechute

tt <- tt |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(dmax = max(c_across(starts_with("date_")), na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(dcd = if_else(status_at_end_study == "Death", 1, 0, missing = 0)) |> 
  mutate(suivi = as.numeric(dmax - date_inclusion)/30.5) |> 
   mutate(repl = paste0(if_relapse_date_m18, 
                        if_relapse_date_m24, if_relapse_date_m36)) |> 
  mutate(repl = stringr::str_replace_all(repl,"NA","")) |> 
   mutate(dmax= ymd(str_sub(paste0(repl,dmax),1,10))) |> 
  mutate(dcd = ifelse(repl >1 ,1, dcd))

dd <- Surv(time = tt$suivi, event = tt$dcd)
ddt <- survfit(dd ~ tt1 + agec, data = tt)
ggsurvplot(
  ddt,
  data = tt,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  pval = TRUE,
  pval.method = TRUE,
  palette = "jco",
  xlab = "Time in months",
  ylab = "Survival probability",
  title = "Survie sans rechute",
  subtitle = "Kaplan-Meier survival curve",
  risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
  risk.table.y.text = FALSE, 
  break.x.by = 6,
  xlim = c(0, 40),
  surv.median.line = "hv",
  legend.title = "Âge",
  #legend.labs = c("80-84", "85-89","=>90")
) 
```

# Rechutes 

```{r}
#| label: rechute
#| tbl-cap: Rechutes

tt |> 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("if_alive_disease_Status")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to =  "Month",
values_to = "Status") |> 
  mutate(Status = as.factor(Status)) |>
  drop_na(Status) |>
  mutate(Month =   fct_recode(Month,
    "M6" = "if_alive_disease_status_m06",
    "M12" = "if_alive_disease_status_m12",
    "M18" = "if_alive_disease_status_m18",
    "M24" = "if_alive_disease_status_m24",
    "M30" = "if_alive_disease_status_m30",
    "M36" = "if_alive_disease_status_m36",
    "M42" = "if_alive_disease_status_m42"
  )) |> 
  tbl_cross(row = Month, col = Status, 
            percent = "row",
            margin = NULL) |> 
    bold_labels() |> 
 gexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur,
            nomsheet = "rechute", lg = TRUE)
```

# Réduction de dose

```{r}
#| label: reduction
#| tbl-cap: Réduction de doses

tt |> 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "Dose reduction") |>
  mutate(`Dose reduction` = as.factor(`Dose reduction`)) |>
  drop_na(`Dose reduction`) |>
  mutate(Month =   fct_recode(variable,
    "M6" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m06",
    "M12" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m12",
    "M18" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m18",
    "M24" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m24",
    "M30" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m30",
    "M36" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m36",
    "M42" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m42",
    "M48" = "if_treatment_ongoing_dosage_reduction_m48"
  )) |> 
  tbl_cross(row = Month, col = `Dose reduction`, 
            percent = "row",
```
